author: template-projects
name: Aspire starter add-on: sign-in (Keycloak locally, Entra External ID in Azure)
description: Adds an identity provider to a scaffold created with aspire-base and a web front end: Keycloak under the AppHost, and an Entra External ID app registration and QA user per deployed environment. The API and front ends already speak OIDC once Auth:* is set; this supplies the provider and the settings. Emits .scaffold/aspire-auth.wiring.md, which lists the AppHost and containerapp.api.tf edits the scaffolding skill applies.

resource.description: Accepted for symmetry with the other templates, so every template in a scaffold takes the same -n and --resource. Nothing in this add-on is named from it.

frontend.description: Which web front end Entra External ID redirects back to. aspire-addon passes the one the scaffold has.
